subject: SIG intake: DPA / SCC applicability and HIPAA gating - implementation questions
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medicarena.com>
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Whitaker <t.whitaker@procureco.io>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: SIG questionnaire submission + three follow-up clarifications

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for taking the time with our security team last week. Attached is MedicaArena's SIG intake and a short list of clarifying questions from procurement about data transfers, the DPA and HIPAA/BAA feasibility. We attached the completed SIG spreadsheet (redwood_SIG_answers_v1.xlsx) and a short DPA clause matrix highlighting a few commercial/legal asks.

Three quick clarifications that will help us move to legal review: 
- For transfer mechanisms: can Redwood commit to SCCs + standard EU DPA when customers request? Are there any carve-outs for cross-border inference caching?
- For HIPAA: is Redwood willing to sign a BAA for Dedicated or Private deployments only, or do you accept BAA for hosted plans too? Please call out any operational controls that are required to be in place before a BAA (e.g., VPC-only ingress, CMEK).
- Subprocessors: we need a current list of subprocessors and whether any have access to unredacted customer inputs for model improvements.

Appreciate a short reply with owners and targeted timing — procurement needs to estimate timeline for contract review.

Best,
Elena
Head of Security and Compliance
MedicaArena

Attachments: redwood_SIG_answers_v1.xlsx, dpa_clause_matrix.pdf

From: logan_wright@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medicarena.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire submission + three follow-up clarifications

Elena —

Thanks for the SIG and clear list. Quick responses below, and I copied Neha (Privacy) and Marcus (Infrastructure) to follow up with concrete artifacts and timelines.

1) SCCs / DPA: Redwood can adopt the EU Standard Contractual Clauses and provide a templated DPA. For hosted customers we use SCCs plus standard data transfer safeguards; the only carve-out is short-lived inference cache replication for performance that never persists beyond 7 days unless explicitly enabled. We'll provide the DPA draft and a mapping doc.

2) HIPAA / BAA: We can sign a BAA but require Dedicated or Private deployment for PHI workloads. Hosted API customers are evaluated case-by-case; for enterprise customers we require CMEK + VPC-peering or VPC egress controls to ensure tenancy and key separation. Marcus will outline the exact operational prerequisites.

3) Subprocessors: we maintain a published subprocessors list; none are given access to unredacted customer inputs for model training by default. I'll attach the latest subprocessor registry and an indication of which subprocessors process telemetry vs model training signals.

Next steps:
- Neha: share DPA template + SCC mapping (ETA 48 hours).
- Marcus: attach short runbook for Dedicated/Private BAA prerequisites and clarify the cache retention policy (ETA 72 hours).
- Logan: I'll consolidate and send an explicit answer to procurement by EOD Wednesday.

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute technical call with Marcus and your infra team.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Cc: logan_wright@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Mar 2027 11:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire submission + three follow-up clarifications

Hi Elena —

Attaching the DPA draft and an SCC mapping doc that highlights the minimal optional language we typically request (see dpa_clause_matrix.pdf). Key notes: 
- Transfer mechanisms: we will use SCCs and include a Supplement for restricted subprocessors on request; caching behavior is explicitly scoped in section 4.3 (7 day max by default, adjustable for Dedicated).
- Data residency: for Private/Dedicated we can pin region; hosted customers can request region pinning subject to capacity.
- Audit evidence: SOC 2 attestation and quarterly security reports available via secure link; we can provide targeted logs under NDA for customers undergoing audits.

HIPAA specifics: 
- BAA: Redwood will execute a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted, we require a pre-engagement security review and additional contractual controls; not impossible, but slower.
- Technical prerequisites: CMEK, VPC-only ingress, and strict key rotation documented in the runbook.

I've added Soojin (trainee on compliance) so she can coordinate the subprocessor export; she'll share an anonymized list indicating which subprocessors touch inference telemetry vs training pipeline. ETA for all attachments: today EOD.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: dpa_clause_matrix.pdf, redwood_dpa_draft_v1.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@medicarena.com>
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Mar 2027 15:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire submission + three follow-up clarifications

Elena —

Thanks for the clear asks. A couple technical clarifications from our infra side: 
- Cache retention: default inference cache TTL is 7 days; Dedicated customers can request a 0-day TTL (no caching) or custom retention as part of the Dedicated configuration.
- CMEK: we support customer-managed keys (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) for Dedicated and Private; for Hosted we can enable CMEK on a per-account premium plan.
- Audit logs & access: we can provide per-tenant audit logs and an immutable upload of API access logs for the contract period under a data export agreement.

I'll attach the HIPAA implementation notes with exact checklist for BAA readiness (hipaa_impl_notes.docx). Happy to run through the checklist with your tech ops team next week.

Proposed slot: Tue 30 Mar, 10:00-10:30 ET — Marcus, Neha, Soojin, Logan. Elena/Tom: does that work for you?

Best,
Marcus
Cloud Infrastructure Lead
Redwood Inference
